comments.text:
The fried fish and fish head soup: After so many years made it to the place. Waiting for 30 minutes for a table. The staffs were busy. Place is much more decorated than what you see in the video. 

Found our spot sharing with two kind strangers- Prita and Anita (Javanese). They were holding our one year old son so that we can eat with ease. They are no longer strangers for us.

The quality of the fish is super A class. As Mark described. Nothing less. Sambal was super spicy ❤. Fried fish was juicy. It is a set menu.

Our heart melted when we found Preta and Anita paid for our meal ! We just met! Indonesian are super welcoming and friendly.  

I will cherish this experience forever. Prita, Anita and Mark . I owe you big time. - Zaved and Farzana
